verdicts.reason: A: the tilted can sits on top of the 'Pier 9' venue text, which is a clear collision. The subtitle wraps so 'of the year' is left alone on its own line. The date block is jammed right under the subtitle, and all the content is crammed into the top 60% of the canvas, leaving a large dead area below. The missing-asset placeholder is still visible. B: a faithful, cleanly ordered scale of the original with no collisions and correct hierarchy and grouping. However, it is mostly a shrunk copy rather than a real rearrangement: there is extra empty space above the logo and below the CTA, the chips and fine print are small at this size, and the missing-asset placeholder box is also still shown.
